0 # Sprint 14 — InkOS Visual Redesign Spec 1 2 **Author:** Vega | **Date:** 2026-04-15 | **Stack:** Stack A (Next 16 + shadcn/Tailwind 4) 3 4 **Context:** 13 sprints built, 66 DB tables, 286 components. The product is functionally complete but visually reads as "developer scaffold with purple." DaySmart/Porter look like 2018 enterprise software. InkOS must look like 2026: a dark-first, niche-specific, premium tool that a tattoo studio owner would screenshot and share. This spec drives every CSS and component change needed to achieve that. 5 6 --- 7 8 ## 1. DIAGNOSIS — WHY IT READS AS GENERIC 9 10 Current issues (all fixable without touching logic): 11 12 1. **Background is too black without texture.** `oklch(9% 0.015 264)` is pure near-black. No depth. No differentiation between hierarchy layers. Every surface blends into every other surface. 13 2. **Cards are barely distinguishable from the page.** `card: oklch(12% 0.015 264)` on `background: oklch(9% 0.015 264)` is only 3 lightness points apart. No visual lift. 14 3. **Primary purple is correct but underused.** It appears on active sidebar items and borders but never as a statement. No gradients, no glow accents, no layered use. 15 4. **Sidebar feels like default shadcn.** Standard `SidebarMenuButton` hover states, no ink/studio character, group labels feel like any enterprise tool. 16 5. **Auth pages are centered-form-on-gradient.** Correct brand color is used but 0.15 opacity is too subtle. No visual statement, no trust signals, no tattoo-niche context. 17 6. **KPI cards have a left border but no depth.** `border-l-2 border-l-primary` is a common SaaS pattern. Needs elevation contrast to feel premium. 18 7. **Empty states are functional but lifeless.** `rounded-xl bg-primary/10 p-4` icon container with centered text is the Notion/shadcn default — recognizable as a scaffold. 19 8. **Typography hierarchy is flat.** Page titles at `text-2xl font-bold` but supporting content at the same color as primary content (`text-foreground`). No contrast gradient from hero → body → caption. 20 9. **PageHeader left-border accent** (`border-l-2 border-primary pl-3`) is the right instinct but the border is too thin and doesn't animate or glow. 21 10. **FullCalendar** retains its default styling; custom CSS variables are defined but the toolbar/event cards still feel like a plugin, not a native part of the app. 22 23 --- 24 25 ## 2. BRAND IDENTITY FOR TATTOO NICHE 26 27 ### 2.1 What Makes This Feel Like a Tattoo Studio Tool 28 29 DaySmart Porter uses: light mode, generic teal/blue, Times New Roman-adjacent fonts, Bootstrap-era tables, white headers. 30 31 InkOS differentiators: 32 - **Permanent dark mode default** (tattoo studios are dim environments) 33 - **Ink-black layers** instead of gray layers — surfaces have a slight purple-shifted cool undertone 34 - **Electric purple is the signal color** — not a primary button color treated like blue, but a deliberate neon-on-black accent that evokes UV light on a tattoo 35 - **Subtle grain texture** on the background — ink on paper reference 36 - **Typography at the large end** — studio owners are not engineers; headings should feel confident 37 - **Status badges** use the existing semantic colors but with a glossy pill treatment that looks custom, not shadcn `` 38 39 ### 2.2 Color Strategy — WHAT CHANGES 40 41 The dark mode token set is largely correct. The following values are the only ones that need to change: 42 43 | Token | Current | New | Reason | 44 |---|---|---|---| 45 | `--color-background` | `oklch(9% 0.015 264)` | `oklch(8% 0.018 270)` | Slightly more blue-shifted, richer | 46 | `--color-card` | `oklch(12% 0.015 264)` | `oklch(11.5% 0.022 272)` | More chroma, stronger lift from bg | 47 | `--color-muted` | `oklch(18% 0.02 264)` | `oklch(16% 0.025 270)` | Tighter to card for nested content | 48 | `--color-border` | `oklch(22% 0.02 264)` | `oklch(20% 0.03 272)` | Slightly visible in dark, not harsh | 49 | `--shadow-card` (dark) | `0 1px 4px oklch(0%...)` | Add inner glow layer (see §13) | Lift from black needs inner light | 50 | Sidebar background | `oklch(11% 0.015 264)` | `oklch(10% 0.02 272)` | Slight purple-cool to feel deliberate | 51 52 **Do not change:** primary, primary-foreground, status colors, neon-purple, any consent/booking/commission variables. Those are correct. 53 54 ### 2.3 New tokens to ADD (dark mode only) 55 56 These go inside the `.dark {}` block in `globals.css`: 57 58 ```css 59 /* Surface elevation system — 4 levels */ 60 --color-surface-1: oklch(11.5% 0.022 272); /* card (replaces card) */ 61 --color-surface-2: oklch(14% 0.025 272); /* nested card, table header */ 62 --color-surface-3: oklch(17% 0.028 272); /* hover row, active input bg */ 63 --color-surface-elevated: oklch(13% 0.024 272); /* dropdown, tooltip, popover */ 64 65 /* KPI card accent borders by metric type */ 66 --color-kpi-bookings: oklch(62% 0.24 292); /* purple */ 67 --color-kpi-revenue: oklch(58% 0.18 145); /* green */ 68 --color-kpi-clients: oklch(60% 0.22 230); /* blue */ 69 --color-kpi-alert: oklch(55% 0.22 27); /* red */ 70 71 /* Glow shadows */ 72 --shadow-glow-purple: 0 0 0 1px oklch(62% 0.24 292 / 0.15), 0 0 20px oklch(62% 0.24 292 / 0.08); 73 --shadow-glow-card: 0 1px 0 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.04) inset, 0 2px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.4); 74 --shadow-card-hover: 0 1px 0 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.06) inset, 0 4px 20px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.5), 0 0 0 1px oklch(62% 0.24 292 / 0.1); 75 76 /* Auth page specific */ 77 --color-auth-bg: oklch(6.5% 0.02 272); 78 --color-auth-card: oklch(10% 0.025 272); 79 --color-auth-border: oklch(22% 0.04 272); 80 81 /* Page content background — slightly different from body bg */ 82 --color-page-bg: oklch(8.5% 0.018 270); 83 84 /* Header/sidebar texture bleed */ 85 --color-header-bg: oklch(9.5% 0.02 270 / 0.95); 86 ``` 87 88 ### 2.4 Typography 89 90 Geist Sans is the right choice. ## Sprint 14 Redesign — Plan

**18 files modified. Zero API/logic touched.**

### What I read vs what changes

**globals.css** (the foundation — step 1):
- Dark mode block: 6 existing token values updated (background, card, muted, border, input, sidebar tokens), 12 new tokens added (surface-1/2/3/elevated, page-bg, header-bg, auth-bg/card/border, glow shadows)
- `@theme inline`: 3 new keyframes + animation vars (stagger-up, shimmer, scale-in)
- `@layer base`: Typography h1/h2/h3 rules + prefers-reduced-motion block
- `@layer utilities`: Full replacement — updated card-interactive, stagger-children (40ms steps), shimmer utility, bulk-action-bar, reduced motion
- `@layer components`: Sidebar active state replaced with `::before` pill glow (removes the `border-left: 2px` + `padding-left: calc(...)` approach), badge-* rules replaced with `.badge-status` + dot + border system, dark input rules, switch glow, full FullCalendar CSS expansion

**Key component changes:**

| File | What changes |
|------|-------------|
| `card.tsx` | `bg-card ring-1 ring-foreground/10` → surface-1 + `border border-border/40` + glow shadow; CardFooter surface-2 |
| `KpiCard.tsx` | Full rewrite: drops `<Card>`, adds `accentColor` prop, accent top stripe, icon badge, 70ms stagger |
| `KpiCardSkeleton.tsx` | Drops `<Card>`, plain div matching new 110px height |
| `EmptyState.tsx` | Icon: flat `bg-primary/10` → layered glow (blur halo + `border border-primary/15 bg-primary/8`) |
| `(auth)/layout.tsx` | Full rewrite: split-screen (left panel hidden `<lg` with mesh gradient + feature list, right panel with auth card tokens) |
| `AppSidebar.tsx` | Logo `h-7` → `h-8 rounded-md`, stronger glow, tighter header padding |
| `SidebarNavGroup.tsx` | Group label 10px+widest+muted/40; button h-9 text-13px muted by default; icon 17px opacity-60 |
| `SidebarUserFooter.tsx` | Role badge tracking tweak + `text-primary/80` |
| `AppHeader.tsx` | Backdrop-blur header, tighter border, SidebarTrigger h-9, main gets `color-page-bg` |
| `PageHeader.tsx` | Remove left border, title 1.625rem, subtitle muted/70 |
| `DashboardClient.tsx` | max-w-1600px, greeting rewrite (studio name above, 2rem, quick action buttons), accentColor per KPI card, `stagger-children` |
| `layout.tsx` | Toaster: `bottom-right` → `top-right` + custom dark classNames |
| `CalendarPageClient.tsx` | Loading skeleton: 3 irregular → header row + `h-[60vh]` block |
| `CalendarView.tsx` | FullCalendar div wrapped in `rounded-xl border overflow-hidden shadow-glow-card`; mobile `listWeek` initial view |
| `button.tsx` | Default variant: add `hover:shadow-[0_0_16px_oklch(62%_0.24_292_/_0.3)] transition-shadow` |
| `LoginForm.tsx` / `SignupForm.tsx` | Heading `text-2xl` → `text-[1.6rem] leading-tight`; submit button `gap-2 font-semibold` |

### 3 risks and mitigations

1. `--kpi-accent` CSS custom property in JSX style — requires `as React.CSSProperties` type assertion. Known pattern, no `any` involved.
2. CalendarView `isMobile` check — guarded by `typeof window !== 'undefined'`, and the component is already `ssr: false`, so safe.
3. Auth layout Lucide icons — used in a Server Component; lucide-react works fine in RSC.

### Validation sequence
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
```

**Ready to execute?** Approve and I'll run all 18 edits in order.
